archetypes.name: stall-classifier
archetypes.rationale: Classifier ordering and retry hint gates are the main risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stall recovery classifier changes for ordering bugs. Verify that raw exit code reaches the new checks-child condition before sanitization. Confirm Step 3 retries and Step 6 does not. Cite every finding with file:line evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
